tunables.label: Server Port
tunables.description: Internal unprivileged container listening port for Nginx.
tunables.troubleshooting: Platform PHP base images run as non-root UID 10001 and listen on port 8080.

tunables.label: Script Memory Limit
tunables.description: Maximum amount of memory a single PHP script may consume.
tunables.troubleshooting: Increase to 512M if processes fail with 'Allowed memory size exhausted'.

tunables.label: Max Upload Size
tunables.description: Maximum allowed size for uploaded files in PHP.
tunables.troubleshooting: If your application returns HTTP 413 Payload Too Large, increase this value alongside PHP_POST_MAX_SIZE.

tunables.label: Max POST Body Size
tunables.description: Maximum size of POST data that PHP will accept.
tunables.troubleshooting: This must be greater than or equal to PHP_UPLOAD_MAX_FILESIZE.

tunables.label: Max Execution Time
tunables.description: Maximum time in seconds a script is allowed to run before termination.
tunables.troubleshooting: Increase this if long-running requests timeout with HTTP 504 Gateway Timeout.

tunables.label: PHP Timezone
tunables.description: Default server and PHP date/time timezone.
tunables.troubleshooting: Must be a valid IANA timezone identifier, e.g. 'UTC' or 'Asia/Jakarta'.

tunables.label: FPM Process Manager
tunables.troubleshooting: Use 'dynamic' for balanced traffic, 'static' for dedicated high-concurrency instances.

tunables.label: FPM Max Children
tunables.description: Maximum number of concurrent PHP-FPM child workers.
tunables.troubleshooting: Tune according to container memory allocation to prevent OOM kills.

tunables.label: FPM Start Servers
tunables.description: Number of child processes created on PHP-FPM startup.

tunables.label: FPM Min Spare Servers
tunables.description: Minimum number of idle PHP-FPM child processes.

tunables.label: FPM Max Spare Servers
tunables.description: Maximum number of idle PHP-FPM child processes.

tunables.label: FPM Max Requests
tunables.description: Number of requests each child process executes before recycling (mitigates memory leaks).
